embedding_method: pinned tokenizer.json, max 128 tokens, onnx/model.onnx CPU inference, attention-mask mean pooling, L2 normalization; embedded text = title + '. ' + bottleneck
limitations: These are concise source-grounded research notes, not peer-reviewed conclusions.
Source coverage was thematic and domain-level, not 999 independent systematic literature reviews; some entries rest on a single source and a few sources are approximate topic matches.

Embeddings capture semantic similarity of short entry text, not scientific correctness; the 0.88 dedup threshold removes near-duplicate phrasing/concepts but is not a claim of conceptual orthogonality.
Sources were public web pages as of 2026-09; links may rot and claims may be superseded.
methodology: Entries were researched from public web sources (review articles, preprints, institutional research pages) during September 2026. Each entry links 1-2 sources found via public search. Near-duplicate concepts were removed by embedding title+bottleneck with the pinned model and replacing one side of every pair scoring above 0.88 cosine similarity, until zero pairs remained above threshold.
